svg.title: Ports and adapters inside the skydiving logbook codebase
svg.desc: Left column: app and components, lib/services.ts composition root, ports interfaces and pure domain code, stacked with imports pointing down. Right: the adapters folder with the existing schema, the Drizzle adapter and the in-memory adapter. The composition root wires adapters, adapters implement ports, the Drizzle adapter talks to Neon, and Vitest with PGlite tests both adapters.
